errors.text: The proposed barrier phases are Mg-rich intermetallics and Fe-Co segregation, whereas the target mechanism depends on uniformly distributed oxide phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The hypothesis predicts Cr2O3 despite chromium not being a constituent of the Mg-Al-Ti-V-Fe-Co alloy; invoking unspecified trace Cr is unsupported.
The falsification experiment uses oxidation at 600 °C rather than the target 900 °C condition, so it may probe a different scale-growth mechanism.
The proposed corrosion potential above 0.1 V versus SHE is inconsistent with the target result and is not supported by the cited analog systems.
